parameters.query:
select l.*, extract(epoch from (now()-l.created_at))/3600 as age_h,
 (select count(*) from message_log m where m.lead_id=l.id and m.template='sms_4h')>0 as sent_4h,
 (select count(*) from message_log m where m.lead_id=l.id and m.template='email_24h')>0 as sent_24h,
 (select count(*) from message_log m where m.lead_id=l.id and m.template='mom_48h')>0 as sent_48h,
 (select count(*) from message_log m where m.lead_id=l.id and m.template='sms_d3')>0 as sent_d3,
 (select count(*) from message_log m where m.lead_id=l.id and m.template='email_d7')>0 as sent_d7,
 (select count(*) from message_log m where m.lead_id=l.id and m.template='sms_d14')>0 as sent_d14
from plumbing_leads l where l.status in ('new','contacted') and l.kind='lead'

parameters.message: Hi {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }}, quick one — the email might have landed in promotions or spam. It has a short video from me and what to expect. Here it is again: {{ $env.SITE_URL }}/#planner. Any questions, just text back.

parameters.subject: What a {{ $json.type }} visit actually looks like
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }},

A lot of women tell me they put off a remodel because they dreaded the consultation more than the work. So here's exactly what mine looks like, so there are no surprises:

  • I come at a time you choose. I take my shoes off.
  • We walk through the {{ $json.type }} and you tell me what bothers you and what you're hoping for. I listen before I say anything.
  • I explain your options in plain language. No jargon, no ego.
  • We talk honestly about cost and timeline. Then I leave, and you get numbers in writing.
  • You ask as many questions as you want. You never decide that day.

If that sounds okay, reply with a day that works or text me at {{ $env.BIZ_PHONE }}. If you'd rather wait, that's okay too.

{{ $env.OWNER_NAME }}

⏰ {{ $json.name }} ({{ $json.type }}, {{ $json.score_tier }}) hasn't booked yet. Email opened: {{ $json.email_opened_at ? 'yes' : 'no' }}. Worth a personal text from your phone today. {{ $json.phone }}

Hi {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }}, {{ $env.OWNER_NAME }} here. No rush at all — just checking whether you'd like to set up that walk-through, or whether you'd rather talk things through by text first. Either is fine 🤍

parameters.subject: From one homeowner in Royersford
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }},

I asked a recent client if I could share what she said, because it's the thing I hear most:

"I had two other contractors in before her. Both talked over me. She asked what I wanted and then actually listened. I hired her that week."

I'm not sharing that to push you. I'm sharing it because if you've had a bad experience before, it doesn't have to go that way.

Whenever you're ready: reply, or text {{ $env.BIZ_PHONE }}.

{{ $env.OWNER_NAME }}

Hi {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }}, last note from me so I'm not cluttering your phone. If a remodel is still on your mind this year, I'm here. If not, no hard feelings at all. Thanks for reaching out 🤍

parameters.query:
=insert into message_log(lead_id, channel, template) values ('{{ $('Open leads').item.json.id }}', '{{ $json.channel || 'auto' }}', '{{ $('Which touch is due').item.json._outputKey || $prevNode.name.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g,'_') }}');
update plumbing_leads set last_touch_at = now(), status = case when '{{ $prevNode.name }}' = 'SMS day 14' then 'cold' else status end where id = '{{ $('Open leads').item.json.id }}';

meta.note: Set these under n8n Settings → Variables. The intake workflow (n8n-dne-workflow.json) writes the lead; this one follows up. Quote, job, and after-job sequences use the same pattern with quotes/projects tables and the templates in FUNNELS-AND-COPY-KIT.md.
